title: GPU not detected after install or reboot
symptoms: nvidia-smi lists fewer GPUs than installed; OS log shows PCIe link down or the device is absent from lspci.
steps: Confirm the count with nvidia-smi -L and lspci | grep -i nvidia.
Check the BMC system event log for PCIe or GPU faults.
Update the GPU baseboard firmware and BIOS to the current validated bundle.
Reseat the GPU module (power off, follow ESD procedure).
If the GPU is still missing after reseat and firmware update, replace the GPU module.

title: NVLink errors or degraded GPU-to-GPU bandwidth
symptoms: nvidia-smi nvlink -e shows rising error counters; training jobs slow down or report Xid 74.
steps: Collect nvidia-smi nvlink -s and -e output for every GPU.
If errors stay on the same link after a cold boot, replace the NVLink switch tray.

title: Power supply fault or redundancy lost
symptoms: BMC reports PSU failure or 'redundancy lost'; one PSU LED is amber.
steps: Check the PSU status and input voltage in the BMC.
Swap the power cord and check the PDU outlet.
If the PSU still reports a fault, replace the PSU (hot-swappable).

title: GPU thermal throttling
symptoms: nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE shows HW Slowdown or thermal throttle; GPU temperature above 85C.
steps: Check fan status and inlet temperature in the BMC.
Confirm data center inlet temperature is within spec.

title: BMC / remote management unreachable
symptoms: BMC web interface and IPMI do not respond; the host OS still runs.
steps: Ping the BMC address from the management network.
Reset the BMC from the host OS (ipmitool mc reset cold).
Update BMC firmware. No hardware replacement is usually needed.
